Definition: produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth
BiblicalUsage: Yebûwl is the produce of the land, the crop and the increase that God gives or withholds. Moses warns that if Israel turns away, the heaven will be shut and the land will not yield her fruit, and Ezekiel promises the tree of the field shall yield her fruit and the earth her increase when God breaks the bands of the yoke.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fruit of the land is God's gift, and the same land that withers under judgment flourishes under His favour.
